title: EscrowEvent
description: Decoded on-chain RiskEscrow.sol event, as persisted by the Go chain indexer. Implemented in Phase F.

quote_id.description: Present on RiskEscrowCreated; the RiskQuote.quote_id consumed to create this deal.

settlement_deadline.description: Present on RiskEscrowCreated; createdAt + RiskQuote.settlement_horizon. The deal becomes refundable once this passes unsettled.
